headline: VIPER PIT watches itself: the fighter's own corner takes seat 1
lede: WATCH batch 30 seats the arcade fighter — press Y and the engine's own tiered CPU brain fights your fighter's corner, mid-round hand-back included. The seat is the same driver the attract bout runs: no new brain, and an honest sweep says exactly what it proves.

notes.text: VIPER PIT joins WATCH (#1637 b30, PR #2051): Y flips seat 1 to the fighter's own ladder tier inside the shared fighting core. Any key or touch takes the corner back; the seat rides the ladder; the title and KING OF THE PIT release it; net/local never seat. Phones get the top-right pill.

New seat law in viperpitcheck: own tier vs LIVE rung 1, 5 fighters × 12 seeds — 60/60 bouts decide, 60/60 drag the foe off full health untouched, every fighter takes ≥8 rounds. A full climb is explicitly NOT claimed (NYX mirrors rung 1 on itself). Mutants prove the gates bite: remove the tier flip → 3 pins red; refuse the seat → 5 live pilot gates red.

Live pilot 301/301: with zero input the corner drove round one (opponent hp 100→47). watchphonecheck 486/486, watchpillcheck 226/226, lint gates + build green; prod entry index-BLZsH_r5.js carries the registry literal.

The b29 candidate list is spent: pacman, centipede, pitfall and mario-classic have no winning script anywhere — they stay honest with no button. b31 is a full-shelf driver audit, or the rollout meets its honest end. Also flagged: viperpitcheck's #1732 qcb gate is deterministically red on main and wired into no CI job — a QA-lane call.
